worker_output.summary: Created comprehensive ship components JSON with 140+ components across 7 categories. Defined full TypeScript types in src/game/types/shipComponents.ts covering all component categories with typed effect interfaces (WeaponEffect, ArmorEffect, ShieldEffect, EngineEffect, FuelEffect, ComputerEffect, SpecialEffect). The JSON includes: 54 weapons (all beam types, missiles with attack rating bonuses, torpedoes, bombs, scatter packs, ground weapons), 7 armor types (Titanium 1.0× through Neutronium 4.0×), 15 shield classes (I–XV with absorption 1–15, correct space/cost formulas), 11 engine types (Retro warp 1 through Temporal Drive warp 9), 10 Battle Computers + 10 ECM Jammers, 11 fuel cell types, and 35 special systems (scanners, cloaking, repulsor beam, stasis field, black hole generator, planetary shields, displacement device, etc.). All 45 component tests pass and all 532 project tests pass with zero TypeScript errors.
